items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: Dr. Sushant and Sherry Manjapain. Sushant on? Guitar.

ctx.x: And who was in it, who was in the banjo bums other than you and Janay?
Dr. Sushant and Sherry Manjapain. Sushant on? Guitar. Manjapain on bass.
Just like the record, in other words. Yes. And what kind of jobs did you play with the banjo bums?
